title: Glowing bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bowl outer -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="36" ry="22" fill="#E85D3A"/>
  <!-- Bowl inner rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="32" ry="18" fill="#FF8A5C"/>
  <!-- Bowl inner dark -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="28" ry="14" fill="#C94428"/>
  <!-- Broth glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="12" fill="#FFD764"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="61" rx="22" ry="9" fill="#FFE99A"/>
  <!-- Noodle swirls -->
  <path d="M32 60 Q40 52 48 60 Q56 68 64 60" stroke="#FFF4C2" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 66 Q46 58 54 66 Q62 74 70 66" stroke="#FFF4C2" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 65 Q36 70 42 65 Q48 60 54 65" stroke="#FFF4C2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 58 Q58 52 64 58" stroke="#FFF4C2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Egg half -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="57" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="57" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#FFC93C"/>
  <!-- Green onion slices -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="56" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6CC24A"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="60" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#6CC24A"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="64" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#7FD65C"/>
  <!-- Steam wisps glowing -->
  <path d="M42 44 Q40 38 44 32" stroke="#FFE99A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50 42 Q48 35 52 28" stroke="#FFE99A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M58 44 Q56 38 60 32" stroke="#FFE99A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Chopsticks -->
  <line x1="60" y1="30" x2="78" y2="72" stroke="#D4A056" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="28" x2="82" y2="70" stroke="#D4A056" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
